failure_summary.description: Answers substituted an associated item or added specificity despite existing guidance to match the clue’s target and level of detail.
The answer combined possible alternatives instead of prioritizing the context’s emphasized, typical answer.
The identified name differed from the gold answer only in hyphenation.

patch.reasoning: Most failures are already covered by target, scope, and name-form guidance, so repeating those rules is unlikely to help. Add a focused rule for choosing a primary answer when context also lists less-common alternatives.

edits.content: When context gives a typical or primary answer alongside less-common possibilities, prefer the explicitly emphasized answer for a conventional fill-in clue; do not combine every compatible alternative into a list unless the question asks for an exhaustive set. Treat generic plural wording as insufficient by itself to require multiple answer items.
